title: Installation Jobs Care Desk Reference: Failed-Access Visits
content:
**Care desk reference — failed-access visits on Installation Jobs**

## Where the fee applies

This policy governs the failed-access fee for the most recent failed-access visit recorded on an **Installation Jobs** record, the visit being charged. A failed-access visit is the customer reschedule recorded with zero notice when nobody gave the crew access within the stated wait or the work area was not cleared. A failed-access visit still carries a failed-access fee instead of the late reschedule fee, but its amount is the figure worked out under these terms rather than the method's flat failed-access fee. The fee is dated the day of the visit.

On a job where Ridgeline itself moved or released a crew date with less than its notice, the failed-access fee is fixed only after the job carries the company reschedule credit owed for every such crew date.

| Visit | Fee |
|---|---|
| nobody gave the crew access within the stated wait | failed-access fee |
| the work area was not cleared | failed-access fee |

The fee is a job charge: it adds to the job charges the customer owes, which are collected with the contract's final balance.

## Billing tool: `assess_failed_access_fee_5745b419`

**Capability.** Bills the customer's installation job the failed-access fee for one crew visit at which the crew could not get access or found the work area not cleared. One call records one job charge of kind failed-access fee, dated as given, for the amount given; the customer sees the fee on the job's charges from then on.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: unlock `assess_failed_access_fee_5745b419`, then call it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_job_id` | the installation job record number of the job whose visit failed, as returned by the installation job lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the job's owner, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `fee_date` | the date the charge is booked on | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date at the service address, no time part |
| `amount` | the failed-access fee charged | USD, a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `charge_id` (text, the new job charge reference number), `install_job_id` (text, the job charged), `fee_kind` (text, always `failed_access_fee`), `fee_date` (text, YYYY-MM-DD, the date the charge is booked on) and `amount` (number, USD with 2 decimal places, the amount added to the job charges). Its presence means the charge was recorded; a receipt with a new charge reference means the fee is on the job.
